Evaluating Newborn Screening Program Data Systems -- Georgia, 1998
This report summarizes findings from an evaluation of data systems for metabolic and endocrine disorders in the Georgia NBS program
During 1998, the NBS laboratory received 199,387* specimens.

methods_quotes.q: All specimens received by the NBS laboratory in 1998 and entered into the database were included in this analysis.
The Georgia NBS laboratory tests all specimens received by the laboratory, including unsatisfactory specimens.
